name: Draw cards
description: Draw value cards for the source's controller.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger. No target.
rulesNotes: An empty deck causes escalating fatigue. Automatic; no 'may' option.

name: Deal damage
description: Deal value damage to a selected creature or player.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger, target: enemy_creature, creature, or creature_or_player.
rulesNotes: creature means either player's battlefield creature. creature_or_player adds both players. If no targets remain, skip the effect.

name: Increase energy
description: Give energy to the source's controller.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger. Optional duration: this_turn or end_of_turn.
rulesNotes: Without duration, energy persists. With duration, unspent bonus energy expires at the end of the active turn.

name: Summon Sporelings
description: Summon value ephemeral creatures using content/tokens/cards.json's token:sporeling definition.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger. No target.
rulesNotes: Only Sporelings are currently supported. Tokens enter tapped and summoning sick, cannot be recovered by Regrowth, and are never collectible.

name: Destroy artifact
parameters: Required: trigger, target: equipment or enemy_equipment. No value.
rulesNotes: Equipment is the retained engine identifier for artifact. equipment allows either owner. Resolution is mandatory when a legal target exists.

name: Destroy augmentation
parameters: Required: trigger, target: enchantment or enemy_enchantment. No value.
rulesNotes: Enchantment is the retained engine identifier for augmentation. enchantment allows either owner. Resolution is mandatory when a legal target exists.

name: Recover creature
description: Return one of your nontoken creatures from the graveyard to your hand.
parameters: Required: trigger, target: creature. No value.
rulesNotes: This target always means your graveyard here. Destination is always hand; damage and bonuses reset. It can survive settlement if it stays out of the graveyard.

name: Modify attack
description: Add value attack; negative values reduce attack.
parameters: Required: value (signed integer), trigger, target. Optional duration for queued effects: this_turn or end_of_turn.
rulesNotes: constant: attached creature or creatures_you_control_with_mycelium_network. Queued: attached creature, all_enemy_creatures, or all_creatures_you_control. on_attack: requires attacking_creature and end_of_turn; applies to every friendly attacker, not just this source. Without duration queued bonuses persist on the match card.

name: Modify health
description: Add value maximum/current health; negative values reduce it.
parameters: Required: value (signed integer), trigger, target. No duration.
rulesNotes: constant: attached creature or creatures_you_control_with_mycelium_network. Queued: attached creature, all_enemy_creatures, or all_creatures_you_control. Queued bonuses persist; constant bonuses disappear when the source stops applying. For the network target, condition: mycelium_network is optional and redundant.

name: Temporarily reduce attack
description: Reduce attack by value until turn end.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger, target, duration: this_turn or end_of_turn.
rulesNotes: Targets: attached creature, all_enemy_creatures, or all_creatures_you_control. Attack is clamped to zero. Permanent reductions use gain_attack with a negative value.

name: Heal attached creature
description: Remove up to value marked damage from the bearer.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger: on_upkeep, target: an attached creature.
rulesNotes: Does not increase maximum health. Artifact must be attached; augmentation uses enchanted_creature.

name: Grant Mycelium Network
description: Give the attached bearer Mycelium Network while this attachment applies.
parameters: Required: value: mycelium_network, trigger: constant, target: an attached creature.
rulesNotes: The only supported granted ability is mycelium_network. This lowercase value is the engine identifier for MYCELIUM_NETWORK.

name: Attack while equipped
description: A creature gains value attack while at least one artifact is attached to it.
parameters: Required: value (signed integer), trigger: on_equip, condition: equipped. No target.
rulesNotes: CREATURE only. This is a derived bonus, not a repeating event; multiple artifacts do not multiply it.

name: Reduce artifact cost
description: While deployed, reduce the controller's artifact play costs by value.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger: constant. No target.
rulesNotes: Does not reduce the attachment cost. Multiple sources stack; play costs cannot be negative.

name: Increase upkeep energy
description: While deployed, add value to the controller's normal upkeep energy.
parameters: Required: value (nonnegative integer), trigger: constant or on_upkeep. No target.
rulesNotes: Both trigger spellings behave identically. Multiple sources stack. Unlike other artifact upkeep effects, this applies even to an unattached artifact.
